skills.description: Compare claims with observable evidence and identify unsupported conclusions.
instructions: Separate observations, inferences and unresolved uncertainty.

skills.description: Trace dependencies and downstream callers before changing shared interfaces.
instructions: Map producers, consumers and compatibility constraints before proposing changes.

skills.description: Localize failures through reproducible observations and controlled hypotheses.
instructions: Reproduce, narrow the cause, test one hypothesis, then verify the fix.

skills.description: Review software changes for correctness, maintainability and regression risk.
instructions: Prioritize boundary violations and observable failures over stylistic preference.

skills.description: Design focused tests around contracts, boundaries and regressions.
instructions: Test externally observable behavior and important negative cases.

skills.description: Organize narrative goals, conflicts and causal progression.
instructions: Connect scene purpose to character motivation and later consequences.

skills.description: Improve structure and clarity while preserving authorial intent.
instructions: Identify the smallest revision that resolves the structural problem.
